_note: PLACEHOLDER SCAFFOLDING, not real marketing copy. EAS's `eas metadata` command (see store.config.json at the repo root) only manages Apple App Store listings as of this eas-cli version — it has no Google Play equivalent. This file is a manual reference for entering the same information into Play Console (Grow > Store presence > Main store listing) or a future `fastlane supply`-style pipeline; nothing currently reads it automatically. Google Play has no 'keywords' field — ASO there comes from the title/short description/full description text itself, which is why 'keywords' below is a research note rather than a submitted field.
